description: This file defines a Flutter widget called RootShell which manages bottom tab navigation with three screens: Home, Search, and Favorites. It uses an IndexedStack to preserve each tab's state and updates the displayed content based on user interaction with the BottomNavigationBar.

classes.name: RootShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the root navigation structure with bottom tabs.

classes.name: _RootShellState
classes.description: The state class managing the active tab index and building the Scaffold with AppBar, IndexedStack, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for RootShell.

methods.name: _onTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the bottom navigation bar, updating the current index.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including AppBar, IndexedStack of screens, and BottomNavigationBar.
